material.description: pages.yml:3-6 triggers on push independently of ci.yml; deploy needs only build. Symptom: tests run beside the deploy and cannot stop it. Acceptance: a recorded decision plus either deploy needs the cheap gates (wire, static) in the same workflow, or a documented rule that a red ci reverts by fix-forward. Witness: workflow run list for one sha showing the ordering.
material.subject: Pages deploys on push without waiting for the ci workflow, so a red workspace test or wire round-trip still publishes
material.witness: verify-pages-deploy-not-gated-by-ci-tests witness RESULT: PASS; CI green on 9d6165006503 (ci 40179272561, pages 40179272563), publishes 220ec688 and 6ac10955
